comment: mthrowu.c spitmm() 1049-1054: a pet spits at another monster, so spitmm() sets gm.mtarget to the monster target (1054). A debug Valkyrie creates a peaceful cockatrice (pets never melee it, dogmove.c dog_move touch_petrifies) and a tame guardian naga, whose first attack is AT_SPIT; pet_ranged_attk() puts gb.bhitpos on the pet, so mattackm() only reaches a ranged attack in slot 0 (a tame cobra's second-slot spit never fires). After the hero steps west the naga lines up with the cockatrice and spits venom.
